prompt: Single continuous shot. Opens mid-action: plump shrimp hitting hot garlic oil in a wave, instantly curling and blushing pink, a rolling sizzle. The camera follows linguine lifted dripping and laid over them. Money shot: a mug of cloudy pasta water poured into the pan — hissing steam flare backlit — as the oil and starch whip into a glossy sauce, tongs lifting shrimp and strands together, sauce sheeting off in macro. Final beat: the tangle plated high, lemon squeezed over it with droplets flying, parsley falling. Warm dramatic light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the shrimp wave hitting oil, then the water hiss. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
